description.value: Farm Country Brewing is a craft brewery and tasting room in Langley, BC, producing a rotating lineup of lagers, IPAs, sours, and stouts—including an award-winning Czech lager. The tasting room offers a full food menu with locally-sourced ingredients and hosts regular live music, trivia, and community events. For a touring cyclist, it's a lively mid-route stop with substantial food options and a wide variety of house-brewed beers available on tap or to go.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces) at 36m; bollard (2 spaces) at 72m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a fully operational craft brewery and tasting room at 20555 56 Ave #5, Langley, BC, with active events listed in May–June 2026. The menu page lists items tagged [V] and [GF], confirming vegetarian and gluten-free options; the online store and front-page delivery copy confirm takeout/online ordering. No website content mentions bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging. The OSM name 'Farm Country Beer Store' differs materially from the website name 'Farm Country Brewing', which is used throughout all pages.
